title: Experimental interoperability demo trust structural schema
description: Explicit synthetic TEST-key configuration for vap-interop-demo/0.2.0. This is a local pinning mechanism demonstration, not evidence of real identity, origin or organizational independence.
$comment: The verifiers enforce strict raw JSON/UTF-8 parsing, duplicate-key rejection, BOM, input-size and depth limits. They require three distinct key IDs and three distinct decoded 32-byte public keys, pin the computed scope digest and enforce every record/event role. A schema-valid configuration alone does not establish trust or cryptographic validity. Base64 patterns constrain padding and unused pad bits; the verifiers decode and validate the keys.

publicKey.description: Canonical padded base64 encoding of exactly 32 bytes; final unused bits must be zero.
